_comment: Expected repository settings. settings-audit.yml compares the live repository with this file on demand. Role id 2 = maintain, 5 = admin; the tag and branch-creation rulesets list both, because the owner of a personal-account repository is an admin and a ruleset that only lets Maintain bypass would lock the owner out of tags. The pull_request object is the COMPLETE parameter object of that rule and required_status_checks_parameters is the complete parameter object of the status check rule without its list of checks: a parameter the live rule has that is not listed here, or another value, is drift. The approvals are counted by the policy check (CODEOWNERS and a fresh approval of the exact head), so native required reviews stay off: they would stop the automatic merge of a pull request that needs no human. For the same reason `require_last_push_approval` is false: with a required approving review count of 0 it can make GitHub refuse the App's merge of an auto pull request; the policy check itself requires a fresh approval of the exact head, and `dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push` stays true.
